question: According to the Llama 3 paper, what type of dialogue training did the speech interface receive, and what prompt format is used for benchmarks like ActivityNet-QA and NExT-QA that require producing a short answer?
gold_answer: The Llama 3 speech interface was trained only on single-turn dialogue. For benchmarks requiring a short answer, the prompt is 'Answer the question using a single word'.

question: In the original Transformer architecture, where do all of the keys, values, and queries come from in an encoder self-attention layer, and in almost all cases prior to the Transformer, what were attention mechanisms used in conjunction with?
gold_answer: In the original Transformer architecture, all of the keys, values, and queries in an encoder self-attention layer come from the output of the previous layer in the encoder. Prior to the Transformer, attention mechanisms were used in almost all cases in conjunction with a recurrent network.
gold_contexts:
• The encoder contains self-attention layers. In a self-attention layer all of the keys, values
and queries come from the same place, in this case, the output of the previous layer in the
encoder. Each position in the encoder can attend to all positions in the previous layer of the
encoder.

Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of compelling sequence modeling and transduc-
tion models in various tasks, allowing modeling of dependencies without regard to their distance in
the input or output sequences [2, 19]. In all but a few cases [27], however, such attention mechanisms
are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
